newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Nov 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British Defence Secretary Michael Portillo is due in the capital Abu Dhabi on Thursday.
- The UAE has given formal approval to the Arabian Investment Corp (Agico) -- traded in Kuwait -- to adjust its share capital and consolidate its paid up shares, the company said on Monday.
- General Motors' Middle East passenger car sales rose by nearly 50 percent in the past four months, GM's regional headquarters in Dubai said.

- The UAE's central bank has agreed to reimburse small depositors at the collapsed bank of Credit and Commerce International's branches in the country next month. Those with deposits of less than 20,000 dirhams will be reimbursed if they submit the proper documents.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines said it would pay for damage caused to farms in India by falling debris after one of its jets collided with another plane in midair on November 12.

- OPEC President and acting UAE oil minister Rakad bin Salem bin Rakad said there was no need to raise the oil production ceiling. He said current OPEC production exceeded the ceiling by one million barrels per day.
